description: CPPLL 3rd-order type-II (R + C1 || C2, CT PM 60 deg placement), impulse-invariant sampling
grid_note: f_MHz: 500 log points 0.1-100 MHz + 1000 linear points 100-2000 MHz (= f_ref/2)
columns_note: ReGamma_* = Re{H_PD conj(G)} of the GMAC regressor pre-filter G: 1diff = 1-z^-1, 2diff = (1-z^-1)^2, D1 = z^-1 (one-cycle correlator misalignment), fx_exact = H_PD (filtered-x with an exact model -> |H|^2).  ReH_Ponly = Re H_PD of the P-only loop.
